name: LMO-U02D
summary: LMO-U02D is a named LH-TC robot tool-changer accessory. Its exact table identifies the interface or mechanical configuration and, where provided, master-side and tool-side specifications. Compatibility is limited to the changer pages that explicitly list this module; it is not assumed universal.
